name: x-easy
description: Use X with one-time browser login. No X API keys, developer app, or password fields.
long_description: X Easy uses a dedicated local Helium/Chrome/Edge/Chromium browser profile. Import it, run x_login once, sign in directly on x.com, then use MCP tools to read the home timeline, search, accounts, threads, mentions, notifications, bookmarks and lists, or explicitly post, reply, like, repost and bookmark. Browser debugging stays on loopback with a browser-assigned random port. Writes are deliberately rate-limited and duplicate-protected.

tools.name: x_login
tools.description: Open the dedicated X login browser

tools.name: get_home_timeline
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's X home timeline

tools.name: get_user_posts
tools.description: Read an X account's recent posts

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read an X post and its replies

tools.name: get_mentions
tools.description: Read posts mentioning the signed-in user

tools.name: open_x_url
tools.description: Open an X URL for manual review

tools.name: x_forget_session
tools.description: Erase X Easy's local browser session
